description: a 4 x 6 x 8 box bored through along z by a cylinder of radius 0.5, then a 1 x 1 column through the same place cut away: the bore is tangent to the column along the four lines x = +-0.5, y = 0 and y = +-0.5, x = 0, so the second cut removes the four corner pieces. V = 192 - 8 = 184, A = 208 - 2 + 4 * 8 = 238, genus 1. Each ruling has the bored box's material on both its sides on the column's wall and the column's on both on the bore, so it is a contact and no section on either face: each wall stays whole, its rim edges split at the vertices where the bore's rims touch them

probes.label: in the box, past the hole

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE imprints the four tangent rulings on the column's walls, splitting each wall in two (24/36/14/16); Arris drops them from both faces, the bored box's material lying on both sides of each on the column's wall and the column's on both sides on the bore: each wall is whole, its rim edges split at the touch vertices (+-0.5, 0, +-4) and (0, +-0.5, +-4) the rulings would end at
